notes.title: About trading cards, achievements and updates
notes.content:
Hi guys, sorry for silent. We want to discuss with you some Osteya aspects. 

We made Osteya on "construct 2" game engine and this was big mistake, very big... At this moment we can't add achivements, steam cloud and optimize our game for mobile's and pc, we have got troubles with mac retina resolution. Thank you, Scirra, thank you, construct 2!

We decided to remaster Osteya on normal engine - Game Maker: Studio. Make game more funny, add a lot of levels, achivements, level editor and more steam features including "Trading Cards". We cant tell the dates, but in Q2 we will post some news about this. 

Osteya remaster will be avaliable for all owners as update, absolutely free.

Stay tuned.  

Best Regards,
MetalBear Team

[url=twitter.com/osteya]Osteya Twitter[/url]
[url=twitter.com/MBStudio]MetalBear Twitter[/url]
